subject.description: Whether the dossier may confirm project claims by its own accumulated vocabulary and volume.

EXTERNAL_CONSTRAINT.note: The file contains 335 pseudo-citation markers but no OOXML hyperlinks or visible URLs; external constraints are mentioned rather than resolved inside the artifact.

NOVELTY_QUARANTINE.note: Later blocks supply counterexamples, but new terms are not consistently registered with a frozen replacement test.

CONSOLIDATION.note: Successive analyses and conversational transitions remain in the active document instead of a separated archive and canonical core.

EXTERNAL_FALSIFIABILITY.note: The dossier stages many objections, but independent evidence capable of forcing rejection is not machine-resolvable from the file.
